text: 金十数据7月31日讯，经查，证监会发现国元证券股份有限公司存在承销保荐项目尽职调查不充分；质控、内核把关不严格；廉洁从业问题排查整改不到位等问题。上述情况违反了《证券公司和证券投资基金管理公司合规管理办法》（以下称《合规办法》）第六条，《证券发行上市保荐业务管理办法》（以下称《保荐办法》）第三十一条、三十七条，《证券公司投资银行类业务内部控制指引》第五十五条、六十一条，《证券期货经营机构及其工作人员廉洁从业规定》第五条的规定。李洲峰作为时任公司投行业务负责人，对相关问题负有责任。按照《合规办法》第三十二条、《保荐办法》第六十四条的规定，证监会决定对其采取
text_en: Jin Shi Data, July 31: After investigation, the CSRC found that GuoYuan Securities Co., Ltd. had issues such as inadequate due diligence in underwriting and sponsorship projects; lax quality control and internal review; and inadequate investigation and rectification of integrity-related issues. These situations violated Article 6 of the "Measures for Compliance Management of Securities Companies and Securities Investment Fund Management Companies" (hereinafter referred to as the "Compliance Measures"), Articles 31 and 37 of the "Measures for the Administration of Sponsorship Business for Securities Issuance and Listing" (hereinafter referred to as the "Sponsorship Measures"), Articles 55 and 61 of the "Guidelines for Internal Control of Investment Banking Business of Securities Companies," and Article 5 of the "Provisions on Integrity Practice for Securities and Futures Operating Institutions and Their Staff." Li Zhoufeng, as the then-person in charge of the company's investment banking business, bears responsibility for the related issues. According to Article 32 of the "Compliance Measures" and Article 64 of the "Sponsorship Measures," the CSRC decided to take [measures] against him.
